title: Welcome to Corpusense

introduction.p1: Corpusense is a web application designed for researchers and professionals who want to work with digitized historical documents simply and efficiently.

features.import: Import documents and select the pages you are interested in to create your custom corpora.
features.process: Process your corpora using features such as text recognition (OCR) and structured data extraction.
features.analyze: Analyze and leverage your documents without needing any particular technical skills.

conclusion: Corpusense turns your digitized documents into structured, usable resources, while remaining intuitive and accessible. Start organizing and analyzing your historical sources with ease right now.
